subject: MAP: POC sprint checklist — org & network gating (API keys, IP safelist, VPC peering)
messages:
From: Olivia Martinez <olivia@healthsync.io>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
Cc: Paul Chen <p.chen@healthsync.io>
Date: Sat, 20 Dec 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: MAP kickoff + POC environment gating

Hi Jasmine —

Thanks for the demo yesterday. Our engineering and security teams want a clear mutual action plan so we can finish evaluation and sign the SOW in January. High level asks from our side: org onboarding (tenant / org id), API keys and quota expectations, IP safelist for our testing CIDRs, and VPC peering for the dedicated test environment.

Can you share a checklist and an expected timeline for a 2-week POC (we're aiming to start Dec 29th)? Also please include who from your side needs to be looped for token creation and peering approvals.

Looking forward —
Olivia

Olivia Martinez
Head of Integrations, HealthSync
olivia@healthsync.io
(415) 555-0193
From: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai

Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 20 Dec 2025 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + POC environment gating

Hi Olivia — great to hear. I've attached a one-page MAP (MAP-healthsync-v1.xlsx) that lays out the sprint tasks, owners, and gating criteria. TL;DR timeline suggestion:

- Week 0 (Dec 29): Org creation and API key issuance (sandbox tenant)
- Week 0-1 (Dec 29 - Jan 5): IP safelist + initial smoke tests
- Week 1 (Jan 6 - Jan 9): VPC peering window + load tests
- Week 2 (Jan 10 - Jan 16): Eval wrap, quality signoff, contract close

Action owners (from Redwood):
- Org & API keys: jasmine_liu (I'll create the tenant and issue scoped API keys)
- Network/VPC peering coordination: neha_kapoor (network ops)
- Staging perf and seq tests: karthik_iyer (runtime team)

Two quick asks for your side to unblock the above:
1) Provide the CIDR ranges you want on the IP safelist (internal + CI runners).
2) Confirm the AWS account id and peering contact for VPC peering (we will need a brief maintenance window).

I've also added a short runbook image (healthsync-network-stub.png) inside the attachment for what we need for peering. I'll schedule a 30-min touchpoint Monday to triage the security questionnaire.

-Jasmine

Jasmine Liu
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Thanks Paul — perfect. Quick updates and acceptance criteria: 

1) Scoped API keys: yes — we will create tenant-scoped keys with hourly rate limits and per-key quota. Key rotation: we will issue initial keys and provide instructions in the MAP; you can request a rotation via the support flow if needed.

2) IP safelist: please confirm the two CIDRs you listed are final. Once confirmed, Neha will add them to the staging allowlist and share firewall rules.

3) VPC peering: Neha, can you propose a 2-hour peering window on Jan 7 (UTC-8 morning) and an internal checklist for both sides? Neha: include BGP/no-BGP notes and the expected route tables we will add.

4) Security questionnaire: per our earlier ask, we'll need one person from your security/compliance team to respond to the SOC2/data flows section. If possible, have that completed by Jan 5 so the peering review can proceed.

Attachments: MAP-healthsync-v1.xlsx (MAP with tasks + deadlines), healthsync-network-stub.png (peering diagram).

Next steps (owner / due):
- Paul: confirm CIDRs and provide any extra CIDRs for test runners (due 2025-12-23)
- Olivia: nominate security responder (due 2026-01-05)
- Jasmine: create sandbox tenant + issue scoped keys (target 2025-12-29)
- Neha: submit peering request draft and propose time windows (target 2026-01-03)

I'll book a 30-minute kickoff for Dec 23 to confirm items you send today.

Thanks —
Jasmine
